Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us for this game. Hope you enjoyed our coverage for the same. We look forward to your company in the ODI series starting on March 15, 2017. Action begins 0930 local time (0400 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai starts off thanking the Almighty. Calls it a proud moment for Afghanistan, having won 11 T20Is in a row. About the score on board, he says that wicket was a good one and 180 was a par score. Credits Mohammad Shahzad for taking responsibility well and Mohammad Nabi for finishing well. He lauds the effort of the bowlers and was always sure of winning the series due to the presence of Rashid Khan. He then thanks the Afghan supporters.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that it was a fantastic game of cricket. Feels that they were in the game till the end but could not finish it off. Congratulates the Afghanistan team for the victory. Opines that bringing the game till the last over showed some grit. Applauds his team for playing some good cricket. Adds that India is a beautiful place to play in. Ends by saying that there would be a couple of new faces who will be joining them for the ODIs.
Plenty of awards to follow. Best Batsman of the series - Mohammad Nabi, Best Bowler of the Series - Rashid Khan, Man of the Match - Mohammad Nabi, Man of the Series - Rashid Khan.

Ireland will be disappointed with the way this T20I series panned out. They had their moments but were always catching up to the all-round skill of Afghanistan. Earlier today, they elected to bowl but allowed the hosts to get away with the game. Shahzad set it up with a 43-ball 72 and Nabi just nailed the Irish bowlers over the park, with a ballistic 89.

Stuart Thompson unfazed by the loss of his partner, carried on the fireworks from the other end before he was castled by Amir Hamza. The middle order once again failed before Gary Wilson stepped up to register his second T20I fifty. He was threatening to take the game away but Rashid Khan then took three wickets in an over to ensure Afghanistan had the game in their kitty. Nabi was the man who hit a 30-ball 89 earlier and he rightly finished off the game in his last over with a wicket.

A spirited chase from Ireland comes to an end, Paul Stirling gave them a blazing start as they notched up 91/1 in the Powerplay. Shapoor Zadran had him dropped off his bowling and he avenged the hits taking the Irish opener down after a 20-ball 49. Ireland did not give up though and kept playing their shots.

OUT! Afghanistan win by 28 runs! Floated outside off, Dockrell goes for a slog sweep but cannot connect it well. The ball goes in the air towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Ghani makes no mistake and pouches a simple catch. Afghanistan whitewash Ireland 3-0 in the T20I series!
Jacob Mulder is the last man in.

OUT! Ireland are falling like a pack of cards! Full delivery on the stumps, Dockrell drills it down the ground towards long on. The batsmen go for a couple and the fielder from long on has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits and Barry McCarthy is long way out! He has to walk back without facing a ball. Ireland need 29 runs off 5 balls.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl the final over. Ireland need 30 runs from 6 balls.
Barry McCarthy is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Googly tossed up outside off, Thompson kneels down and goes for a slog down the leg side. He misjudges the ball completely as it goes onto clip the bails. Brilliant over by Rashid Khan.
Dockrell works it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
George Dockrell is the new man in. Ireland need 31 more runs in 8 balls.
OUT! Cleaned up! Slider in the line of the stumps, Tucker tries to make room and smack it on the leg side. He misses it completely and Rashid Khan strikes again.
Floated outside off, Tucker charges down the track and drives it through covers for a couple.
Greg Thompson comes out to bat.

OUT! Tossed up outside off, Wilson goes for a slog sweep but cannot time it well. Gets a top edge to it and the ball flies towards the mid-wicket region. Shenwari runs forward to take a really good catch. Wilson's brilliant innings comes to an end. Rashid finally strikes!
Short ball this time by Rashid, Wilson drags it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. 200 runs up for Ireland.

Fails to improvise this time! Tucker shuffles across and goes for the scoop. He misses the full ball outside off completely and that is a dot ball whoich flies away straight to the keeper. 35 runs needed off 12 balls.
Wilson clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That's what Ireland need! Full length around off, Wilson tries to slog it on the leg side but manages to get a thick inside edge which runs fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Angling into the pads, Tucker works it through square leg for a single.
Free Hit coming up! Ireland need 41 more in 16 balls.

No ball! Angling into the pads, Tucker smashes it over the mid-wicket region. Ghani,  fielder from deep mid-wicket rushes towards his left and drags it back just in time to save the boundary. The batsmen run a couple. Zadran has overstepped so a free hit is coming.
Full toss in the line of the stumps, Wilson heaves it through the square leg region. A single is taken.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Wilson tries to pull it away but the ball was too far. The umpire signals it as a wide.
2nd T20I fifty for Gary Wilson.
Wilson gets to his fifty! Full outside off, Wilson elegantly drives it through the cover region for a couple. A very well composed innings by the keeper and he will want to make it bigger.
Shapoor Zadran called back on for his final over. Ireland need 48 runs in 18 balls.

Huge shout for LBW! Wrong 'un pitched outside off, Wilson tries to cut it late but he ends getting an inside edge which goes towards the short fine leg fielder for a single. The players appeal for an LBW but the umpire stays put.
Into the stumps, Tucker punches it through mid-wicket for a single.
Wilson sweeps it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Floated outside off, Tucker lofts it over mid off for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Tucker cannot make contact with it.
SIX! Another biggie! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Tucker gets down the track and smacks it over the long on region for a biggie!
Outside off, Tucker cuts it through the point region for a single.
Wilson punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Full delivery into the stumps, Wilson lofts it over the mid on region for a boundary. Top shot!
Full outside off, Wilson throws his bat at it but misses.
SIX! That's gone the distance! Floated in the line of the stumps, Wilson gets to the pitch of the ball and smacks it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Tucker eases it down towards long on for a single.
Mohammad Nabi returns for a bowl.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Wilson defends it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Down the leg side, Wilson clips it towards short fine leg. The fielder there gets a hand to it but parries it towards deep square leg. Najeeb Tarakai from the deep, throws it towards the keeper as the batsmen go for the second run. The keeper collects it and dislodges the bail as Wilson dives to get into the crease. They appeal and the umpire goes upstairs to check for run out. Replays show that the dive saved the batsmen and they successfully completed two runs.
A run out appeal against Wilson has been referred upstairs. Looks not out.
Full and quicker outside off, Wilson goes for a slog but misses it completely.
Tucker cuts it through point for a single.
Wilson eases it down towards long on for a single.

Dropped! Almost a collision! Tossed up delivery outside off, Wilson goes for a biggie on the leg side. Ends up getting a leading edge which flies towards the fielder at point. Shapoor Zadran from short third man, wants to take it and dives to his left. Stanikzai reaches to it and dives forward to catch it but the ball bounces off his hands. The skipper has let his star bowler down. Thank god though, there was no collision between the two.
Angling into the pads, the batsman dances down the track and pushes it back to the bowler. Ireland need 75 more in 36 balls.
Length delivery outside off, Tucker goes to push at it but misses.
Lorcan Tucker is the new man in.

OUT! Pays the price for innovation! Full delivery into the stumps, Andrew McBrine goes for the predetermined reverse scoop. He misses it completely and gets rapped on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger up. McBrine has to depart and Janat strikes!
SIX! Angling across from a length, Andrew McBrine shuffles across, picks the length well and swings it over the square leg region for a maximum.
Angling into the pads, Wilson clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery around off, Wilson lofts it over the bowler's head through the mid on region for a couple. That was good running.
Wrong 'un outside off, Wilson reads it well and heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Down the ground! Wilson hammers the full delivery down the ground, through the mid on region for a boundary.
Floated in the line of the stumps, McBrine dances down the track and lofts it towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, McBrine cuts it past the diving point fielder for a couple.
Wrong 'un outside off, Wilson cuts it through the point region for a single.
Tossed up around off, Wilson pushes it back to the bowler.
Rashid Khan called on for a bowl.
Full into the stumps, Wilson eases it down towards long off for a single.
SIX! All the way! Fuller delivery outside off, Wilson smacks that over the cover region for a maximum.
Good length delivery outside off, Wilson cuts it through the point region for a couple.
Back of a length on the body, McBrine pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length around off, McBrine dances down the track and goes for a biggie but misses it completely.
Down the leg side, McBrine clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! Much needed! Full outside off, Wilson cuts it through the point region for a boundary.

Down the leg side, Andrew clips it on the off side and rushes for a single. Rashid, the fielder at cover has a shy at the stumps on the non-striker's end and he hits. The umpire goes upstairs to check for a run out. Replays show that luckily he had his foot just inside the line.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs against Andrew McBrine at the non-striker's end.
On the pads, Wilson clips it on the leg side for a single.
Andrew McBrine is the new man in.

OUT! Porterfield throws it away! Short delivery again into the stumps, Porterfield tries to loft it over long on but he cannot find the desired contact. Nabi comes running in to take a fine catch and Porterfield has to make his walk back to the hut!
Short into the stumps, Porterfield stays in his crease and pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Down the leg side, Porterfield drags it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Wilson drags it through mid-wicket and they get a couple of runs. Ireland need 117 runs in the next 10 overs.
Length ball outside off, Porterfield heaves it through square leg for a single.
Fuller and around the stumps, Wilson clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Smart batting! Wilson backs away, Karim looks to bowl it wide of him, but it is just in the range for Wilson to unleash a fierce cut to get it in the gap between point and short third man for a boundary.
Length ball around off, Porterfield backs away and hits it down to long on for a single.
Length outside off, dabbed towards point for a single.

Flatter on the stumps, William backs away to put it away but ends up hitting it back to the bowler, down the wicket. Wilson had to dive to get back into his crease as the bowler tried to run the non-striker out with a throw but Wilson was in.
Lands it outside leg, William goes for the reverse sweep but finds two fielders at point who dive into each other and stop the run. A run taken.
Fired on the pads, Wilson clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, turned through square leg for a single by William.
Fired on the stumps, turned through mid on for a single.
Lands it on off, William clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Porterfield drives it on the up through mid off for a single.
Gary Wilson makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Kevin O'Brien has thrown it away! Fuller outside off, KOB looks to loft it over long on but he fails to find the desired contact and Nabi dives forward and takes a safe catch. That is a big wicket for Afghanistan and Ireland once again are losing wickets in a flurry. They need 134 more in 73 balls.
Fuller on leg, clipped to long on for a single. 100 up for Ireland!
Bowls it outside off, KOB punches it on the up through mid off for a single.
Beaten! Slants it outside off, Kevin looks to run it down to third man but fails to put bat to ball.
Fuller outside off, Kevin hits it hard towards extra cover.
Karim Janat is introduced into the attack.
Shorter on off, Porterfield goes back to cut but finds the fielder at covers.
KOB walks down and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Too full on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Kevin O'Brien arrives at the crease.

OUT! You miss, I hit! Flatter on off, Thompson looks to go over the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his stumps. The keeper and the bowler celebrate the wicket and another vital wicket for Afghanistan!
FOUR! Smacked in the gap! Hamza bowls from the round the wicket, Thompson stays back and hits it hard through covers for a boundary.
Amir Hamza is back into the attack.
Driven through covers for a run. End of a brilliant Powerplay for Ireland!
SIX! Another biggie! On the pads, Thompson gets under it and clobbers it over mid-wicket for another biggie.
SIX! Smacked! This one is on the stumps, Thompson gets under it and dispatches it over the head of the bowler for a maximum.
Fired on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on the stumps, Thompson looks to swing it over mid-wicket but gets it towards the off side off his thigh pad.
Angles it on the stumps, William clips it towards mid on for a single. He is off the mark.

Back of a length delivery into the body, Thompson hits it over the mid off fielder with a straight bat. The fielder from long on covers some distance towards his right and makes a fine stop to save the boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Full length delivery outside off, Thompson lofts it over the cover region for a boundary. They seem to be dealing only in boundaries.
Good length delivery outside off, Thompson tries to reach at it but he cannot. Finally a dot ball.
SIX! Thompson takes over the charge! Length delivery into the stumps, Thompson stays in his crease, trusts the bounce and hammers it over the long on region for a biggie.
William Porterfield comes out to bat at 3.

OUT! Stirling departs! Low full toss outside off, Stirling shuffles across and clips it over the mid-wicket region. Nabi covers some distance to his right and takes a fine catch. Stirling misses out on a fifty by mere one run. Finally a much needed wicket for Afghanistan. 169 runs needed off 94 balls.
SIX! Freebies for Stirling! Full into the stumps, PS smacks the free hit ball over the long on region for a maximum.
Free Hit coming up!
FOUR and no ball! Brilliant for Stirling! Shapoor oversteps this time and bowls this on a shorter length. Stirling reads the length early and smashes it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Short in the line of the stumps, Thompson stays deep in his crease and smacks it over the mid-wicket region. The ball went very high but just over the ropes for a maximum.
Floated around off, Thompson tries to heave it across the line but gets an inside edge into his pads.
Tossed up outside off, Stirling clips it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Stirling is the man! Short and wide outside off, Stirling camps back and smashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
On the pads, Stirling clips it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Quicker one to start with, pitched outside off. Stirling cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Mohammad Nabi comes on for a bowl.
Length delivery outside off, Thompson tries to heave it but misses it completely.
SIX! Up and over! Back of a length delivery outside off, Stuart Thompson stays in his crease and hammers it over the cover region for a maximum. Even he joins the party now.

Dropped again! Stirling is living a charmed life! Down the leg side, Stirling shuffles across and drags it towards the fielder at fine leg. Karim Janat runs a bit towards his right to gather it but fails to hold onto it. The batsmen run a single.
The physio is out on the field attending to Thompson. He hurt his hamstring while attempting the second run on the previous ball. He is fit to continue though.

Dropped! Angling it down the leg side, Stirling drives it powerfully towards the fielder at covers who cannot hold onto it. The ball goes through him and the batsmen manage to run a couple. Stuart Thompson was seen limping while completing his second run and even pointed towards the dressing room to call the physio.
There is a deep fine leg in place now.
Back of a length outside off, Stuart Thompson pushes it towards covers for a quick single. The fielder picks it up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Length delivery outside off, Stuart goes for a biggie but gets an inside edge into his pads.
FOUR! Timed to perfection! A bit short outside off, Stirling dances down the track and pierces it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Quicker one into the pads, Stirling drives it crisply to the fielder at extra cover.
FOUR! Makes room and smashes! Tossed up outside off, Stirling makes room and frees his arms to it as he slaps that one over covers for a boundary.
SIX! That's way into the crowd! Tossed up around off, Stirling dances down the track and smacks it powerfully over the long on region for a biggie. This man is looking dangerous.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Paul lunges forward and drives it straight towards mid off.
Angling into the stumps, Stirling drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Amir Hamza to bowl from the other end.
Short into the body, Stirling comes down the track and defends it on the off side for a single. Seemed like it came off the chest for a moment. Good start for the Irishmen.
SIX! In the arc...out of the park! Full around off, Stirling stays in his crease and hammers that one over the long on region for a biggie.
Full outside off, Stirling dances down the track and plays an inside out shot over the point fielder for a couple.

FOUR! One bounce into the ropes! Length down the leg side, Stirling picks up the length well and helps it on its way towards fine leg for a boundary. The umpire was not sure if it was a maximum or a boundary and hence was referred upstairs. Replays showed it bounced before the ropes and the same was conveyed to the on-field umpire.
Thompson stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! On a length down the leg side, Stirling tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and the batsmen run a leg bye.
The players are out in the middle for the chase. Paul Stirling and Stuart Thompson will open the innings for Ireland. Shapoor Zadran will bowl the first over for Afghanistan.
